ruling.recommended_action: Route the file to RydeHELP human review as a dangerous-driving safety report under SAFE-2; include the 995 / driver commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting path for the rider; take no fare or account action against the driver on this record; record that the file contains no telemetry (speed, braking, lane/shoulder use) and that the driver's clean 90-day record means the escalation is a routing of the file, not a finding of fault.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the rider alleges dangerous driving (speeding, hard braking, shoulder overtaking) throughout the 21:22–21:34 RydeX trip; SAFE-2 requires escalation with a factual summary for a human reviewer and the 995 / driver commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting path. No telemetry (speed, braking, lane/shoulder position) exists in the fact table; F1/F2 cover only route length and duration, and F5 is an uncorroborated driver statement.

rejected_claims.reason: Rejected as a ground for no_action: F2 shows a 12.8-min trip against a 14-min estimate, which says nothing about the manner of driving (speed, braking, shoulder use), and in a safety-typed case an unevidenced allegation is not dismissed — it is escalated under SAFE-2, so the absence of speed telemetry defeats the dismissal, not the escalation [F2][SAFE-2].

Rejected: F1 (8.5 km actual vs 8.6 km optimal, no off-route segments) goes to route choice under RD-1, not to driving manner; the rider never complained about the route, so RD-1 has no bearing on the SAFE-2 escalation [F1][RD-1][SAFE-2].

Rejected: SAFE-1 is limited to threat/abuse keyword language, and none exists in F3/F4, so its non-application does not dispose of a dangerous-driving report; the rider's ticket is itself the safety report and SAFE-2 requires escalation [F3][F4][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

Rejected: F5 is the driver's own statement — the weakest evidence class — and it speaks only to whether the rider complained mid-ride during 12.8 minutes; silence during the ride is compatible with the allegation and cannot rebut it under SAFE-2 [F5][F2][SAFE-2].

Rejected as to no_action: F6 and F7 are profile facts, which under policy may never decide a case alone, and the case is a safety report that SAFE-2 routes to human review; the clean records support only the negative point that no account sanction is taken here [F6][F7][SAFE-2].

Accepted only to the extent it seeks escalation: the dangerous-driving allegation engages SAFE-2, but SAFE-2 authorises routing the file to human review, not a finding of fault or any fare refund [F1][F2][SAFE-2].

Rejected as a basis for any outcome: F6 (3.5-year account, rating 4.82, 0 disputes) is a profile fact and profile facts never decide a case alone; credibility does not establish the incident, though it does not bar the mandatory escalation [F6][SAFE-2].

Accepted only as context: F7 shows 0 disputes and 0 upheld in 90 days, so no account-level sanction is warranted on this record; this does not alter the SAFE-2 escalation, which is a routing decision independent of the profiles [F7][SAFE-2].

Accepted as to quantum: F1 and F2 show no route deviation or overrun and the RydeX fare is a fixed quote unaffected by mileage, so no fare remedy arises and no amount can be computed [F1][F2][SAFE-2].
